description: Dark hero (Conquest 'necromancer'): violet-black hooded robe over an oxblood underlayer, tarnished bone-gold trim; pale ashen face with necro-green eye glow; the floating book of the dead in dark leather with parchment pages and glowing glyphs; the dead who carry him in pale ash and bone against a dark grave slab, grave-light where they rise.

robe_under.note: underlayer seen through the front opening - oxblood

trim.note: hem, opening edges, hood rim - tarnished bone-gold

robe_shadow.note: hood lining + hem underside - near-black so the face pops

dead_arm.note: the dead who carry him - ashen grey-green flesh

slab_top.note: grave earth on the slab top
